title: Scriptorium Reorganization Proposal v1
description: An offline, human-reviewable, diff-able plan for bulk library reorganization. Produced by an LLM, an agent, or a human (all three are equivalent producers); executed by Steward `apply` only after review. This file IS the audit artifact.

target_tree.description: Complete list of valid target collection paths. When present, every proposal target MUST be in this list (apply validates).

title.description: Item title echoed for human review and reconciliation; apply matches by key only.

targets.description: Target collection paths. First entry is the primary home; the rest are secondary memberships.

confidence.description: Producer's confidence. Low-confidence entries SHOULD be re-reviewed by a human before apply.

needsReview.description: Explicit flag: a human must look at this entry before apply.

note.description: Producer's reasoning, especially for low confidence or adjudicated entries.

currentCollections.description: Collection paths at proposal time (for review context and drift detection).
